select p.*, c.name AS category_name, s.uname AS seller_name, pi.filename AS thumbnail_filename from tbl_product p left outer join category c on p.category_id = c.category_id left outer join tbl_user s on p.seller_id= s.uid left outer join tbl_product_img pi on p.pno = pi.pno and pi.ord = 0
order by pno desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select * from category order by category_id asc

SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, s.uname AS seller_name, pi.image_id, pi.pno AS image_pno, pi.filename, pi.image_type, pi.ord, pi.file_url FROM tbl_product p LEFT OUTER JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tbl_user s ON p.seller_id = s.uid LEFT OUTER JOIN tbl_product_img pi ON p.pno = pi.pno WHERE p.pno = #{pno} ORDER BY pi.ord ASC
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_product (pname, pdesc, price, category_id, stock, status, seller_id) values (#{pname},#{pdesc},#{price},#{categoryId},#{stock},#{status}, 5)
insert into tbl_product_img (pno, filename, image_type, ord, file_url) values (#{pno}, #{filename},#{imageType},#{ord},#{fileUrl})
